pairing_note: The counted statement is the author's proposition environment at source lines 20388-20395 (label proposition-perfect-is-compact): for an object K of the derived category of a ring, being perfect and being a compact object are equivalent. The proof environment at source lines 20397-20506 immediately follows it and is its own proof: the forward direction represents a perfect object by a bounded complex of finite projective modules, identifies Hom out of that complex with the Hom complex, computes its cohomology as a product of Hom modules and concludes that a map out of K into a direct sum factors through finitely many terms; the converse takes K compact, produces a bounded complex of finite free modules mapping to it with a one-sided inverse, splits that complex by the induced idempotent endomorphism and identifies K with a direct summand of a perfect object.
